provenance.paper_title: Reflective Dialogue between Teacher and Solver Agents for Video Question Answering

representation_paths.memory_component: Reflective Dialogue history containing support questions answers feedback and visual grounding reflections

evidence.paraphrase: Natural-language multi-turn dialogue history used as inference-time context. the constructed dialogue history is injected as context at inference time instead of direct fine-tuning.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): The full-paper lifecycle review found Reflective Dialogue history containing support questions answers feedback and visual grounding reflections fixed during downstream inference; query-conditioned access, preprocessing, or training-time changes were not counted as persistent deployed updates. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
